utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Kira — I can check what’s left and help with it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for Saturday morning, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — Saturday morning still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m mostly trying to sort out the timing and see who can bring the tools before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can help gather the neighbor list and check who can bring tools. Once that’s set, we can pin down the pickup times and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks — if you can check the tool situation first, I can figure out who needs to move what and when.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and send over a short list of what I still need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — send me the list, and I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and check-in table. I’m ready whenever you are.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — I’ll send that list right over and keep you posted as the rest comes in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you confirmed the first repair yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Can you check the list and tell me the first repair when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — that’d help a lot. I’m still putting together the short note and getting the neighbor list sorted, then I’ll send it around and we can nail down the pickup times and meet-up spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and send along anything useful I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the latest—did they confirm if the repair drive is happening Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, it’s set for Saturday. Rey’s bringing the tools and will be there around 10, so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — Saturday at 10 works for me. I’m glad Rey’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Rosa — keep it short and I’ll stay posted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. Just let me know what tools you can spare, and keep it short.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I’m still double-checking the list so I don’t get it wrong. I’ll confirm the first repair and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, Hana—take your time and just let me know when you’ve got the first repair confirmed. I’ll be there with the tools as soon as I wrap up next door.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—I’ll confirm the first repair and let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping track of the supplies, and so far we still need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and spare batteries. If anyone can help sort the donations when they arrive, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the donation spots as they come in and keep an eye on where they’re posted. Send me any locations you confirm, and I’ll track them down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send you the confirmed donation spots as I get them. That’ll help me keep the supply notes in order for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I don’t have those details yet—can you send me the date, time, drop-off spot, and the needed items list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t have the details handy yet, either—I’m probably the wrong one to ask. If I hear the update, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — please let me know if you get the update, and I’ll share it with Mara.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll make sure Sam hears all the details too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still good for Saturday morning, and I’ll bring the tape, screwdrivers, and spare batteries. Just let me know if there’s anything else you want me to do when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Sam — thank you! Just bring yourself and those supplies, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’m keeping track of our supplies, and I still need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and any spare batteries you can bring. If you can help sort donations when you get here, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I can bring tape, a couple screwdrivers, and any spare batteries I’ve got. I’ll also help sort donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. I’ll keep note of what’s coming and see you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — if you spot any new repair drive locations while you’re out, just let me know and I’ll keep track of them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you confirmed what’s being repaired first, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t confirmed that yet—I only know it’s still in planning. If I hear what’s first, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — please let me know as soon as you hear what’s first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can bring a sturdy hammer, a screwdriver set, and work gloves. I’ll try to be there around 10 so we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds great, Rey — those will come in handy. I’ll keep my tools ready, and just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling neighbors about the repair drive, and I’ll make sure Uli gets the details too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate you spreading the word and keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep sharing the details and let you know if anything changes. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still don’t have the repair drive details yet. Can you send me the date, time, drop-off spot, and the needed items list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — we’re aiming for 10:00, and I’ll have folks drop things off at my garage. We need a sturdy hammer, a screwdriver set, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — I’ve got the time, drop-off spot, and needed items now. I just need the date before I can share it with Mara.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today. I’ll go check the list and see what’s still left, then I’ll get back to you in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No rush — just let me know what’s still needed when you check, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll take a look and let you know what’s still needed as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed it yet, so I’m checking the list first. I’ll let you know the first repair as soon as I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — that helps. I’m still worried about timing and moving things first, so just tell me what the first repair is when you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the list now, and I’ll tell you the first repair as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m still trying to wrap up next door, but I should be able to swing by a bit late with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane — just come by when you can and bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’m finishing up next door now and should head over soon with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure I caught the start date—did they say when the repair drive begins?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the start date yet, but I can ask around and get it for you. Once I know, I’ll help share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I’d appreciate that. I’m a bit behind on the details, so just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can handle the sign-up sheet and check-in table. Just send me the repair drive date, time, drop-off location, and any needed items list so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the date, time, drop-off spot, and needed items list soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll watch for those details and get the sign-up sheet and check-in table ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — it’s still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m keeping it organized and confirming the locations now. I’ll send the updated list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, thanks — I’ll wait for the updated list.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
